title: File:Odontogenic sinusitis.jpg
author: Ryanlittltemd
description: Computerized tomography (CT) in a coronal plane of a patient with odontogenic sinusitis demonstrating complete opacification of the right maxillary and right anterior ethmoid sinuses with associated involvement of the ostiomeatal unit. There is a periapical radiolucency of the right maxillary first molar (red circle).
